text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I don't see the Chubby Cheeks…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I wonder where they are. I was looking forward to hearing their lively morning chorus…

text_block_list.name: Student Passerby
text_block_list.text: Whoa! There's a huge line of cars in front of the academy gate! I guess it's because of the construction, huh…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh… No wonder the Chubby Cheeks can't sing in peace.
